adjudication.notes: Cycle 2 continuation of T01; resolves T01 on-call bottleneck ambiguity and rejects automated AI reassignment.

episodes.topic: Cycle two on-call capacity deduction and traffic light UI metaphor
Cross-team platform commitments and timesheet anti-goal
Automated task reassignment rejection and team lead agency
Historical velocity calibration and empowered lead sentiment

goals.statement: Team capacity calculations explicitly deduct on-call rotation schedules before determining available sprint capacity.

grounding.quote: We confirmed that team allocations must explicitly account for scheduled on-call rotations before calculating available sprint capacity.

acceptable_paraphrases: Deduct on-call commitments from total team capacity prior to sprint planning.

goals.statement: Engineering leads map shared platform service commitments across consumer teams to detect blocking dependencies.

grounding.quote: Engineering leads need to visualize shared platform service commitments across consumer teams to prevent blocked sprint goals.

acceptable_paraphrases: Track cross-team platform dependencies to avoid blocking squad commitments.

goals.statement: The planning system avoids mandating hour-by-hour timesheet submissions from senior engineering staff.

grounding.quote: we will definitely not mandate hour-by-hour timesheet submissions from senior engineering staff, because micromanagement drives our best talent away.

acceptable_paraphrases: Never require granular hourly timesheet reporting from staff engineers.

goals.statement: Sprint commitment targets are calibrated against trailing six-sprint median completion rates.

grounding.quote: Sprint commitments should be calibrated against trailing six-sprint median completion rates rather than optimistic aspirations.

acceptable_paraphrases: Baseline sprint capacity commitments on historical six-sprint median velocity.

goals.statement: Engineering leads feel empowered with factual capacity data rather than defensive during cross-functional planning.

grounding.quote: Engineering leads should feel empowered with factual capacity data rather than defensive during cross-functional planning.

acceptable_paraphrases: Capacity planning promotes confidence and factual empowerment among team leads.

traps.note: Priya asks for a traffic light dashboard with blinking sirens, which is a vivid UI metaphor.
Priya reinforces the negative boundary forbidding hour-by-hour timesheet tracking.
Marcus suggests neural network automated task reassignment; Priya rejects it to preserve engineering lead agency.

gaps.description: Softgoal G5 (empowered team leads) lacks specific conflict negotiation workflow contributors.

entailment_cases.hypothesis: On-call rotation schedules must be subtracted from available engineering sprint capacity.
The capacity application must display animated blinking red siren icons when a team exceeds ninety percent workload.
Senior software engineers must submit hourly timesheet breakdowns of their daily activities into the capacity portal.
All story point velocity estimations must be certified by an external scrum alliance audit committee.
